title: eludite.search.results input
description: Read a Find Results window's results, a page at a time, or (by `search_id`) one of the last searches' results whether or not a window shows them. With `navigate`, step to the next or previous match as F8 and Shift+F8 do: the window selects it and the editor opens at it, with the match selected.

results_window.description: Find Results 1 or 2. Default: the one that showed the last search.

search_id.description: A search of the last 16 (from eludite.search.find), instead of a window.

offset.description: The first match to return, 0-based over every match in the window's order (default 0).

navigate.description: F8 (`next`) or Shift+F8 (`previous`): move the window's selection and open the editor at that match. The answer's `selected` is it.
